result.instructions: Tools for Smaregi, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Show yesterday's sales transactions of my Tokyo store."; "Which products are low on stock in store 2?"; "Change the price of product 1042 to 1,980 yen.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Smaregi data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run smaregi_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run smaregi_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run smaregi_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. smaregi_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: smaregi_list_stores
tools.title: List stores
tools.description: List the stores (shops) of the Smaregi contract: id, code, name, address, phone. Use the ids to filter stock and transactions. GET /stores.

fields.description: Comma-separated top-level field names to return (e.g. productId,productName); fewer fields = smaller replies.

sort.description: Sort order: comma-separated field names, ':desc' for descending (e.g. updDateTime:desc).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: smaregi_get_store
tools.title: Get store
tools.description: One store by id. GET /stores/{store_id}.

fields.description: Comma-separated top-level field names to return (e.g. productId,productName); fewer fields = smaller replies.

tools.name: smaregi_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List products with id, category, code, name, price, cost and update time. Filter by category, code, group code, display flag or update time (a 31-day maximum range). GET /products.

category_id.description: Only products of this category id.

product_code.description: Only the product with this exact product code.

group_code.description: Only products with this group code.

supplier_product_no.description: Only products with this supplier product number.

updated_from.description: Only products changed at or after this date-time (ISO 8601 with timezone).

updated_to.description: Only products changed at or before this date-time (the range may span 31 days at most).

fields.description: Comma-separated top-level field names to return (e.g. productId,productName); fewer fields = smaller replies.

sort.description: Sort order: comma-separated field names, ':desc' for descending (e.g. updDateTime:desc).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: smaregi_get_product
tools.title: Get product
tools.description: One product by id, optionally with store prices, bundled items, store assignments, reserved stock, attribute items and order settings. GET /products/{product_id}.

tools.name: smaregi_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List customers (members): id, code, number, name, phone, e-mail, address. Smaregi cannot search by name, phone or e-mail: filter by customer code, member number, id range or update time, or page through. Contains shoppers' personal data. GET /customers.

customer_code.description: Only the customer with this exact customer code.

customer_no.description: Only the customer with this member number.

customer_id_from.description: Only customers with an id at or above this.

customer_id_to.description: Only customers with an id at or below this.

updated_from.description: Only customers changed at or after this date-time (ISO 8601 with timezone).

updated_to.description: Only customers changed at or before this date-time (31 days at most).

fields.description: Comma-separated top-level field names to return (e.g. productId,productName); fewer fields = smaller replies.

sort.description: Sort order: comma-separated field names, ':desc' for descending (e.g. updDateTime:desc).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

fields.description: Comma-separated top-level field names to return (e.g. productId,productName); fewer fields = smaller replies.

tools.name: smaregi_list_stock
tools.title: List stock levels
tools.description: List stock levels per store and product (stockAmount, reserved amount). Filter by store or product. Smaregi only lists a product once its quantity has changed at least once. An update-time filter needs both bounds (31 days at most). GET /stock.

updated_from.description: Only stock changed at or after this date-time (give updated_to as well).

updated_to.description: Only stock changed at or before this date-time (give updated_from as well).

fields.description: Comma-separated top-level field names to return (e.g. productId,productName); fewer fields = smaller replies.

sort.description: Sort order: comma-separated field names, ':desc' for descending (e.g. updDateTime:desc).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: smaregi_list_stock_changes
tools.title: List stock history
tools.description: The stock change history of one product in one store: date, amount, division (sale, purchase, transfer, adjustment...). GET /stock/changes/{product_id}/{store_id}.

target_date.description: Only changes of this target date, as Smaregi formats it (yyyy-mm-dd).

stock_division.description: Only changes of this stock division code.

fields.description: Comma-separated top-level field names to return (e.g. productId,productName); fewer fields = smaller replies.

sort.description: Sort order: comma-separated field names, ':desc' for descending (e.g. updDateTime:desc).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: smaregi_list_transactions
tools.title: List transactions
tools.description: List sales transactions (receipts) in a time window of at most 31 days: id, date-time, division (1 = normal sale, 2 = deposit, 3 = withdrawal...), store, terminal, customer, totals. Optionally with the line items (limit 100 then). Contains shoppers' personal data. GET /transactions.

from.description: Start of the window: transaction date-time (when Smaregi received it), ISO 8601 with timezone.

to.description: End of the window (at most 31 days after from).

transaction_head_division.description: Transaction division: 1 normal sale, 2 deposit, 3 withdrawal, 4 advance payment, 5 advance refund, 6 points added, 7 points deducted, 8 points expired, 9 coupon ticket, 11 tip, 13 miles added, 14 miles deducted, 15 value card deposit, 16 receipt.

transaction_uuid.description: Only the transaction with this receipt number.

with_details.description: Add the line items: none (default), summary or all. Any other value than none caps limit at 100.

fields.description: Comma-separated top-level field names to return (e.g. productId,productName); fewer fields = smaller replies.

sort.description: Sort order: comma-separated field names, ':desc' for descending (e.g. updDateTime:desc).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: smaregi_get_transaction
tools.title: Get transaction
tools.description: One transaction (receipt) by its transaction id (transactionHeadId), optionally with line items, discounts and payments. Contains personal data. GET /transactions/{transaction_id}.

tools.name: smaregi_create_customer
tools.title: Create customer
tools.description: WRITE: create a customer (member). customerCode, firstName and lastName are required; the contract's own required-column settings may demand more. Not idempotent: calling twice with a different code creates two customers. POST /customers.

entryDate.description: Enrollment (membership start) date, yyyy-mm-dd; some contracts require it when creating a customer.

pointExpireDate.description: Point expiry date, yyyy-mm-dd; some contracts require it when creating a customer.

mailReceiveFlag.description: Whether the customer accepts guidance mail: 0 = refuse, 1 = allow (default).

storeId.description: Store id the customer belongs to.

status.description: Member status: 0 = active, 1 = suspended, 2 = card lost, 3 = withdrawn, 4 = merged.

tools.name: smaregi_update_customer
tools.title: Update customer
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of one customer (only the fields you pass are changed). Overwrites the old values. PATCH /customers/{customer_id}.

entryDate.description: Enrollment (membership start) date, yyyy-mm-dd; some contracts require it when creating a customer.

pointExpireDate.description: Point expiry date, yyyy-mm-dd; some contracts require it when creating a customer.

mailReceiveFlag.description: Whether the customer accepts guidance mail: 0 = refuse, 1 = allow (default).

storeId.description: Store id the customer belongs to.

status.description: Member status: 0 = active, 1 = suspended, 2 = card lost, 3 = withdrawn, 4 = merged.

tools.name: smaregi_create_product
tools.title: Create product
tools.description: WRITE: create a product. categoryId, productName and price are required. Not idempotent. POST /products.

taxDivision.description: Tax division code (0 = tax included, 1 = tax excluded, 2 = tax free).

productPriceDivision.description: Price division: 1 = standard price (default), 2 = open price.

displayFlag.description: Show on the register (0 = hidden, 1 = shown).

division.description: Product division: 0 = normal (default), 1 = prepaid multi-use ticket (only contracts with that feature), 2 = option product.

salesDivision.description: Sales accounting: 0 = counted in sales (default), 1 = excluded from sales totals. Does not control whether the product can be sold; use displayFlag to hide it from the register.

stockControlDivision.description: Stock control: 0 = stock is managed (default), 1 = stock is not managed.

tools.name: smaregi_update_product
tools.title: Update product
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of one product (only the fields you pass are changed), for example its price or name. Overwrites the old values. PATCH /products/{product_id}.

taxDivision.description: Tax division code (0 = tax included, 1 = tax excluded, 2 = tax free).

productPriceDivision.description: Price division: 1 = standard price (default), 2 = open price.

displayFlag.description: Show on the register (0 = hidden, 1 = shown).

division.description: Product division: 0 = normal (default), 1 = prepaid multi-use ticket (only contracts with that feature), 2 = option product.

salesDivision.description: Sales accounting: 0 = counted in sales (default), 1 = excluded from sales totals. Does not control whether the product can be sold; use displayFlag to hide it from the register.

stockControlDivision.description: Stock control: 0 = stock is managed (default), 1 = stock is not managed.

tools.name: smaregi_set_stock
tools.title: Set stock level
tools.description: WRITE: set the absolute stock quantity of one product in one store, replacing the current quantity. Use smaregi_adjust_stock for a relative change. PATCH /stock/{product_id}.

memo.description: Note stored in the stock history.

tools.name: smaregi_adjust_stock
tools.title: Adjust stock level
tools.description: WRITE: add (positive) or subtract (negative) a quantity to the stock of one product in one store. Not idempotent: a repeat applies the change again. POST /stock/{product_id}/add.

stock_amount.description: The change: +5 adds five, -3 removes three.

memo.description: Note stored in the stock history.
